Make reckon.mcp._edit_plan return the one-shape version_conflict refusal, never raise VersionConflict, when the store detects a conflict after the edit's version read. Commit a landing write to the same plan between the edit's version read and its write, through a monkeypatched hook in the test. Name the line that let the exception through. The refusal carries expected_version, current_version and a message naming both, exactly as section 11's other paths return it. Record the outcome in docs/evidence/fragments/plan-writes-are-not-fenced/a-lost-race-is-refused-not-raised.html.
